title: Design an Array Statistics Tracker
summary: Implement StatisticsTracker with addNumber, removeFirstAddedNumber, getMean, getMedian and getMode. Removal is FIFO. Mean is rounded downward; median is the upper middle value for even size; tied modes choose the smallest value. Initialize empty and answer statistics over the current multiset.
